acceptance_rule: Old actions cannot override a reopened lot; same-lot actions still repeat until share reconciliation; current strategy/backtest behavior is unchanged.

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: Pending actions bound only to ticker and share count can survive a full close and be applied to a reopened lot; binding every action to current-lot lifecycle identity and expiring lifecycle mismatches will prevent stale overrides without changing strategy rules or order submission.

nearest.reopen_condition: A retry needs materially different PIT shareholder-yield evidence such as explicit completion/progress fields, free cash flow coverage of buybacks, or closed forward replacement-value rows. Do not sweep share-count contraction thresholds, fact age, price guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
New snapshots generated with advisory_shadow_actions and later closed forward outcomes/replacement value; quote_time_et or broker bar IDs remain useful before any executable action contract.
Need broader forward/current-stack payment-network outcomes or a true business-model field before retrying this cohort.
Revisit only with a materially new PIT tail-state or flow field and direct replacement-value evidence versus the accepted low-deployment ETF comparator.

A valid retry needs settled forward replacement-value rows from a daily default-off precursor logger, daily snapshot parity, or an orthogonal PIT qualifier such as non-OHLCV flow/borrow/options context; not another OHLCV volume-threshold retune.

observed_only_streak_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 forward-row attribution: after 3 consecutive observed-only closes on one data_source population, a further observed-only probe needs materially more settled rows, a new data source, or a new gate shape.

reopen_condition_guard.rule: If a parked surface has a quantitative reopen_condition, alpha-lane reservations that target that surface are blocked until the numeric reopen checks pass, unless the ticket names a genuinely new data source or a new gate shape.

routine_materialization_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 routine delta materialization: after 3 routine forward-ledger materialization IDs (one concrete surface, or same-shape across surfaces within 7 days), wire the materialization into run.py / the settlement pipeline once instead of reserving further manual IDs. Fault recovery is exempt.

saturated_source_axis.rule: For saturated (gate_shape, data_source) cells, legal override axes are limited to a new data source, a new gate shape, or materially more closed/settled forward rows. Same-source new fields/tags do not qualify.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Ticker/share-only matching, non-persistent reconciliation, and reminder re-registration allowed an old action to survive a full exit and attach to a reopened lot; broker position_id reuse made that identifier unsafe too.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not restore ticker-only matching, use broker position_id as lot identity, or bootstrap historical actions from today's holdings without PIT snapshots.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A concrete concurrent-writer loss, multi-account collision, corporate-action/transfer case, or sub-day broker fill identity.
